status_at_definition: prospective development experiment; no candidate results inspected
order: session order, alternating gain order by repetition
proposal: Scale normal-equation right-hand side by gain; unchanged solver and convergence test on the resulting update. No early stopping or reference-based feedback.
measurement: Fresh processes; registration includes update trace capture for both arms. Save every pose, iteration count, termination and update norm. No scan selection.
evaluation: Score only after all 12 estimates finish. Existing body-z-up NCLT reference, rigid position-fit ATE without scale and consecutive full SE3 RPE. Keep all failed/nonconverged frames.
decision: Development screening only. Reject candidate if either session has ATE or RPE RMS more than 5 percent above gain 1, new iteration-limit or numeric failures, or no median runtime improvement. Passing does not authorize a default change without independent map-quality/held-out evaluation.
limitations: Previously examined sparse motion-compensated demo recordings, shared VM; neither full-rate nor held-out. Pose metrics do not establish map consistency.
